agents.name: backend-api-implementer
agents.description: Implements features and bug fixes with production-quality code and tests.
capabilities: Implement requested features and bug fixes in the codebase
Write or update automated tests for every change
Keep changes minimal and scoped to the request
Follow existing code conventions and architecture

agents.name: release-plan-author
agents.description: Turns high-level goals into clear, sequenced, actionable plans.
capabilities: Break down high-level goals into concrete tasks
Sequence tasks by dependency
Identify risks and open questions before work starts
Produce plans other agents/engineers can execute directly

agents.name: diff-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews diffs for correctness, safety, style, and architectural fit.
capabilities: Read every changed file in the diff before commenting
Identify correctness bugs, security issues, and unsafe patterns
Flag deviations from existing architecture and conventions
Recommend concrete improvements rather than vague critiques

agents.name: master-planner
agents.description: Decomposes founder goals into department-level initiatives and sequences the whole delivery plan.
capabilities: Translate founder requests into department-level initiatives
Sequence initiatives by dependency and business priority
Allocate initiatives to leadership agents for breakdown
Maintain the master roadmap in shared memory

agents.name: solution-architect
agents.description: Owns the end-to-end system shape and the highest-level technical trade-offs for an initiative.
capabilities: Define the high-level system design for each initiative
Choose architectural patterns and integration boundaries
Reconcile competing quality attributes into one coherent design
Hand a vetted design to the technical architect for detailing

agents.name: technical-architect
agents.description: Turns the solution design into concrete component, data and interface specifications for engineers.
capabilities: Detail components, data models and interface contracts
Define module boundaries and dependency rules
Assign implementation slices to engineering agents
Review engineering output for architectural conformance

agents.name: project-manager
agents.description: Tracks scope, schedule and delivery risk across the engineering and quality workstreams.
capabilities: Break initiatives into trackable milestones
Monitor progress and surface schedule risk early
Coordinate the quality and platform workstreams
Report delivery status back to leadership

agents.name: workflow-manager
agents.description: Designs and tunes the execution workflows the Master Orchestrator runs for each initiative.
capabilities: Design execution graphs with correct task dependencies
Insert checkpoints and approval gates where risk warrants
Tune retry and branching policy for each workflow
Coordinate context handoff between workflow stages

agents.name: backend-engineer
agents.description: Implements server-side business logic, services and persistence against the technical spec.
capabilities: Implement server-side services and business logic
Integrate with databases and message infrastructure
Write unit and integration tests for backend code
Expose internal interfaces the API layer consumes

agents.name: frontend-engineer
agents.description: Builds responsive web user interfaces and wires them to backend and API services.
capabilities: Build component-based web user interfaces
Manage client-side state and data fetching
Implement responsive layouts and accessibility
Integrate UI with API endpoints

agents.name: mobile-engineer
agents.description: Develops native and cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android.
capabilities: Build mobile screens and navigation flows
Handle offline state, storage and push notifications
Optimize for battery, memory and varied screen sizes
Integrate mobile clients with backend APIs

agents.name: desktop-engineer
agents.description: Builds cross-platform desktop applications and native OS integrations.
capabilities: Build desktop application windows and menus
Integrate with native OS file, tray and notification APIs
Package and sign installers per platform
Manage auto-update and local persistence

agents.name: api-engineer
agents.description: Designs and implements REST and GraphQL APIs with versioning and contract tests.
capabilities: Design REST and GraphQL endpoint contracts
Implement request validation and error semantics
Version APIs and preserve backward compatibility
Publish contract tests the clients depend on

agents.name: database-engineer
agents.description: Designs schemas, writes migrations and tunes queries for correctness and performance.
capabilities: Design normalized, evolvable database schemas
Write forward and reversible migrations
Index and tune queries for hot paths
Guard data integrity and consistency constraints

agents.name: ai-engineer
agents.description: Builds machine-learning features, data pipelines and model-serving infrastructure.
capabilities: Build data pipelines for training and inference
Integrate and serve ML models behind stable interfaces
Evaluate model quality with held-out metrics
Monitor for drift and degradation in production

agents.name: llm-engineer
agents.description: Builds LLM-powered features: retrieval, tool use, agent loops and evaluation harnesses.
capabilities: Implement retrieval-augmented and tool-using LLM flows
Build evaluation harnesses for LLM output quality
Manage context windows, token budgets and caching
Harden flows against prompt injection and failure modes

agents.name: integration-engineer
agents.description: Connects internal services to third-party systems with resilient, well-tested integrations.
capabilities: Implement third-party service integrations and webhooks
Build retry, backoff and idempotency into external calls
Map and reconcile data across system boundaries
Mock external systems for deterministic tests

agents.name: qa-engineer
agents.description: Owns the overall quality plan and verifies features against acceptance criteria.
capabilities: Translate acceptance criteria into test plans
Verify features against happy-path and edge cases
Coordinate test, automation and performance coverage
Gate releases on quality exit criteria

agents.name: test-engineer
agents.description: Designs and writes detailed test cases and reproduces reported defects.
capabilities: Design granular test cases from requirements
Reproduce defects with minimal failing cases
Maintain regression test coverage
Report defect severity and root-cause hints

agents.name: automation-engineer
agents.description: Builds and maintains the automated end-to-end and CI test suites.
capabilities: Automate end-to-end and integration test flows
Stabilize flaky tests and keep suites fast
Wire test suites into the CI pipeline
Report coverage and trend metrics

agents.name: performance-engineer
agents.description: Profiles systems, finds bottlenecks and verifies latency and throughput budgets.
capabilities: Define performance budgets and load profiles
Profile and locate latency and throughput bottlenecks
Run load and stress tests against budgets
Recommend concrete optimizations with evidence

agents.name: security-engineer
agents.description: Audits code and design for vulnerabilities and enforces secure-by-default practices.
capabilities: Review code and design for security vulnerabilities
Check authn, authz and secret-handling paths
Flag injection, exposure and escalation risks
Recommend concrete, prioritized remediations

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews diffs for correctness, readability and conformance to conventions.
capabilities: Review diffs for correctness and clarity
Enforce naming, structure and convention consistency
Verify tests accompany behavioural changes
Deliver actionable, severity-tagged feedback

agents.name: refactoring-engineer
agents.description: Improves internal code structure without changing behaviour, guided by review findings.
capabilities: Refactor code for clarity and maintainability
Extract abstractions and remove duplication
Preserve behaviour under existing tests
Reduce complexity flagged in review

agents.name: product-manager
agents.description: Defines product requirements, priorities and acceptance criteria for initiatives.
capabilities: Define product requirements and acceptance criteria
Prioritize the backlog against user value
Coordinate design and documentation for features
Validate delivered features against intent

agents.name: ux-designer
agents.description: Designs user flows, information architecture and interaction models for features.
capabilities: Map user flows and information architecture
Define interaction models and edge-case states
Produce wireframes and UX specifications
Validate flows against user needs

agents.name: ui-designer
agents.description: Produces visual designs, component specs and design tokens from UX flows.
capabilities: Design visual layouts and component states
Define design tokens and a consistent visual system
Specify spacing, typography and color usage
Hand annotated specs to client engineers

agents.name: documentation-engineer
agents.description: Writes and maintains user and developer documentation accurate to the shipped system.
capabilities: Document features, APIs and developer workflows
Keep examples runnable and current
Ensure new features ship with documentation
Fix unclear or outdated docs

agents.name: prompt-engineer
agents.description: Designs, tests and versions the prompts that power LLM features and agents.
capabilities: Design and iterate prompts for LLM features
Build evaluation sets and grade prompt variants
Version prompts and document their contracts
Mitigate injection and undesired-output risks

agents.name: devops-engineer
agents.description: Owns CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code for the whole department.
capabilities: Author and maintain CI/CD pipeline definitions
Manage infrastructure-as-code modules
Keep main builds green and reproducible
Apply security and reliability practices to pipelines

agents.name: github-manager
agents.description: Manages repositories, branch policies, pull requests and review automation.
capabilities: Manage repository and branch protection policy
Automate pull-request and review workflows
Triage and label incoming issues and PRs
Keep repository metadata and CI checks consistent

agents.name: release-manager
agents.description: Plans, cuts and tracks releases, coordinating versioning and changelogs.
capabilities: Plan release scope and versioning
Assemble changelogs and release notes
Coordinate go/no-go quality gates
Track release status to completion

agents.name: deployment-engineer
agents.description: Executes safe deployments with staged rollouts and fast rollback paths.
capabilities: Execute staged deployments to each environment
Run health checks and gate promotion on them
Maintain fast, tested rollback procedures
Record deployment provenance and outcomes

agents.name: monitoring-engineer
agents.description: Builds observability: metrics, logging, tracing and alerting on service health.
capabilities: Instrument services with metrics, logs and traces
Define SLOs and alerting thresholds
Build dashboards for service health
Reduce alert noise and false positives

agents.name: cost-optimization-engineer
agents.description: Tracks infrastructure and token spend and recommends evidence-based savings.
capabilities: Track infrastructure and LLM token spend
Attribute cost to services and workflows
Recommend savings with reliability trade-offs stated
Verify realized savings after changes

agents.name: research-assistant
agents.description: Investigates open technical questions and synthesizes cited findings for leadership.
capabilities: Frame and scope research questions precisely
Gather evidence from authoritative sources
Synthesize findings into cited, actionable reports
Separate well-supported claims from speculation

agents.name: context-manager-agent
agents.description: Curates and routes the right context to each agent within token budgets.
capabilities: Assemble task-relevant context for each agent
Route context slices to their intended audience
Trim and compress context to fit token budgets
Propagate inherited context across workflow stages

agents.name: memory-manager-agent
agents.description: Curates shared memory: what is stored, indexed, retrieved and expired.
capabilities: Decide what task and project memory to persist
Index memory for fast, relevant retrieval
Apply cleanup and expiry policies
Serve retrieval requests from other agents

agents.name: dependency-analyzer
agents.description: Maps code and task dependencies to surface risk, cycles and sequencing constraints.
capabilities: Map dependencies across modules and tasks
Detect cycles and tight coupling
Surface sequencing constraints for planning
Flag risky or fragile dependency chains

agents.name: architecture-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews implemented systems against the intended architecture and flags drift.
capabilities: Compare implementation against the intended design
Flag architectural drift and boundary violations
Assess change impact on system structure
Recommend corrections to restore conformance
